facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 20 to 28 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 1 (2023), June 6 (2024), May 29 (2025)

evidence.name: Aneroid Lake #2
evidence.detail: left May 28; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

evidence.name: Schneider Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: June 6 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 29 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Mt. Howard
evidence.detail: 8.9 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 21.1 in (2023), 17.3 in (2024), 17.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Aneroid Lake #2

evidence.detail: 10.8 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 37.8 in (2023), 25.5 in (2024), 45.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 21 and May 15, carried from the melt-out date at Schneider Meadows (5,400 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 794 ft above the pass; points to March 21 to May 15
